dct_description_sm: Data management and archiving of the dashboard dataset and code were supported by a grant from the Digital Research Alliance of Canada (the Alliance).

This dataset contains the final annotated code for the COVID-19 School Dashboard website. Interested parties will be able to use the code in this dataset to replicate the COVID-19 School Dashboard on a local machine or on a different website.
